title: ieee80211: add dissection of S1G PV0 control frames
description:
This adds dissection of S1G PV0 control frames with subtype not equal
to 3 or 10. These are slightly different from non-S1G PV0 frames.

- Bandwidth indication and Dynamic Indication control field subfields
  as indicated in 9.3.1.1 802.11ah-2016.

- HT control field NUM_STS, VHT-MCS and BW subfields as indicated
  in 9.2.4.6.3 802.11ah-2016.

Dissection of S1G PV0 control frames with subtype equal to 3 or 10
has not been implemented.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18606/diffs?diff_id=1223049419&start_sha=c32b47e57ece1bc41840ecef9d6ce68f0ad9b8ad#17db83fabbbb3bb40cb8fa5ffd0d1a14b2a2cfb3_33_31)
I removed this in one force push. Marking thread as solved.
can you share some pcap ?
requested changes

Here is a PCAP containing a single S1G control frame that can be used to test these changes. Something to note about this frame is that it contains a Compressed BlockAck response in which the SSC has the fragment wrongly set to 9 instead of 0. As far as I can tell, this is a bug in the equipment that generated this frame (it is ignoring the fact that the SSC is split into sequence number and fragment, and thus putting the sequence number 0x709 partly into the fragment part). 802.11ah-2016 doesn't introduce any changes for BlockAck frames, and it looks to me that Wireshark with this MR is dissecting correctly. Other transmitter bugs in this frame are Bandwidth Indication = 1 MHz (it should be 2 MHz), and Coding Type LDPC in the +HTC (this should be BCC as far as I can tell, since both stations are using BCC).

[s1g_control_frame.pcap](/uploads/c7534626d69242b81dc18a767c030e1c/s1g_control_frame.pcap)
I've seen a problem with this MR, which is that the changes also affect Data frames (and they shouldn't). I will fix this and force-push.
